tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done: the buggy function is `applyDiscount`, and the one-line fix is below.

## Findings
- Bug is in `applyDiscount` at `/tmp/v4orch/w/t1/src/pricing.ts:5-8`.
- Line 6 comment says `pct` is a whole number (10 = 10%).
- Line 7 `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct));` uses it as a fraction. With `pct = 10`, `1 - 10 = -9`, so the price becomes negative (`cents * -9`) instead of 90% of `cents`.
- Fix (line 7):
  ```ts
  return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));
  ```
- Alternative if callers already pass fractions: change the comment on line 6 to match. The comment reads as the intended contract, so the code is the side to fix.

## Verification
Read `/tmp/v4orch/w/t1/src/pricing.ts` in full (12 lines); no edits made.

## Open issues
None. I did not check callers of `applyDiscount` for what they pass in, so it is unconfirmed whether any caller already divides by 100.
